title: Capsule sprite sheet
description: A sprite sheet: the texture it cuts from, the sockets and boxes its frames set, the events its clips raise, its frames and the clips played over them.

$schema.description: The URL of this file's JSON Schema, which gives an editor completion and hover. The build ignores its value.

formatVersion.description: The document format's version, which must be one this build supports.

texture.description: The key of the texture every frame is cut from, extension included, with forward slashes and no empty, "." or ".." segment. Any spelling of the key reads.

sockets.description: The sockets the frames set. Absent or empty generates no Sockets class.

name.description: The socket's name, unique among the sockets. Letters, digits, '-' and '_', not starting with a digit.

boxes.description: The boxes the frames set. Absent or empty generates no Boxes class.

name.description: The box's name, unique among the boxes. Letters, digits, '-' and '_', not starting with a digit.

events.description: The events the clip entries raise. Absent or empty generates no Events class.

name.description: The event's name, unique among the events. Letters, digits, '-' and '_', not starting with a digit.

frames.description: The regions of the texture the sheet names, at least one.

name.description: The frame's name, unique among the frames. Letters, digits, '-' and '_', not starting with a digit.

x.description: The frame's left edge in texels of the texture.

y.description: The frame's top edge in texels of the texture.

pivot.description: The pivot as [x, y] in texels of the frame from its own top-left corner, both finite. Absent is that corner.

sockets.description: A declared socket's name mapped to its point on this frame, [x, y] in the pivot's texel space. A frame sets the sockets it has a point for and leaves the rest out.

boxes.description: A declared box's name mapped to its rect on this frame, in the pivot's texel space. A frame sets the boxes it has a rect for and leaves the rest out.

x.description: The box's left edge in texels of the frame, finite.

y.description: The box's top edge in texels of the frame, finite.

width.description: The box's width in texels, positive.

height.description: The box's height in texels, positive.

clips.description: The animations played over the sheet's frames. Absent or empty is a sheet of frames only, with no Clips class generated.

name.description: The clip's name, unique among the clips. Letters, digits, '-' and '_', not starting with a digit.

loop.description: Whether the last entry wraps back to the first.

frames.description: The frames the clip plays in order, at least one.

frame.description: The name of a frame of this sheet.

ticks.description: The fixed steps the frame is held for, at least one. Not milliseconds.

events.description: The declared events this entry raises as it starts, each listed once. Absent is none.

source.description: What a derived sheet came from. Nothing reads it.

tool.description: The tool that derived the sheet.
